challenge.name: The Loyalty Data Audit
challenge.description: A legal audit flagged that loyalty basket data lacks valid consent records, breaking the legal basis for using it in forecasts. #requirements_reuben# demands the data contracts be fully automated and governed to enforce consent checks before any data enters the pipeline. #efficiency_emilia# argues that manual review is sufficient for now to avoid delaying the promotion planning cycle, though she might accept a middle ground if it does not stall the weekly leaflet.

output.content: The legal audit has confirmed that our current consent records for loyalty basket data are invalid. Until we establish a solid legal basis, this data cannot touch the forecast pipeline. I am mandating that data contracts must be in place before anything consumes this data. A contract that is missing or broken means personal data flows with no stated rules, and I will not approve any workflow like that. Please understand this is not a suggestion. Writing the contract by hand and checking it by hand is fine for now, but it has to exist and it has to be in force. If the contracts are missing, nothing goes live.
output.reclassify_reason: The text explicitly defines a hard requirement and refusal line, stating that any workflow allowing personal data to flow without documented approval will be rejected, which constitutes a boundary that cannot be crossed.
